title: Kwang-Gae

symbol.name: Kwang-Gae
symbol.meaning: King Gwanggaeto the Great · ITF pattern 10 of 24

note.h: 土 · Kwang-Gae · the king who expanded the realm
note.p: Kwang-Gae is named after Gwanggaeto the Great, the 19th king of Goguryeo, who won back the lost territories including much of Manchuria. The diagram 土 (earth) stands for that recovered land, and the 39 movements for the first two figures of 391, the year he came to the throne. You start in parallel stance with a heaven hand in the middle of the A–B line facing D: slow upset punches, double steps with palm hooking blocks and sliding knife-hand low guarding blocks down toward D; palm upward blocks back toward C; pressing and side kicks to E and F from closed stance with knife-hand and side-fist strikes; slow palm pressing blocks in low stance; stamping back fist strikes and double forearm blocks along the C–D line; then twin fist punches, front kicks, guarding blocks and high punches to A and B.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (39 movements, one technique each). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the short line across the stem. The moves back along the C–D line (21–31) are drawn in the bottom row so the stem stays readable; their real place is between the short line and the start. Finish by bringing the left foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in parallel stance with a heaven hand: feet parallel, both open hands raised in front of the forehead to form a triangle.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into close ready stance B facing D, bringing both hands down in a circle, slowly.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance. Right upset punch, slowly.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Left upset punch, slowly.
Double step: move the left foot to the side front of the right foot, then the right foot to D into a right walking stance. Right palm high hooking block.
Slide the right foot back toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Double step: move the right foot beside the left foot, then the left foot to D into a left walking stance. Left palm high hooking block.
Slide the left foot back toward C into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Move the left foot to D into a right rear foot stance (left foot forward on its ball, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand high guarding block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a left rear foot stance (right foot forward on its ball, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand high guarding block.
Move the left foot to the side front of the right foot, then pivoting on the left foot turn counter-clockwise into a left walking stance facing C. Right palm upward block, slowly.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance. Left palm upward block, slowly.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance facing C. Right knife-hand low front block in a circle, striking into the left palm.
Left pressing kick toward E, the hands held where they were.
Without setting the foot down, left middle side piercing kick toward E.
Lower the left foot toward E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right knife-hand high inward strike, the left side fist in front of the right shoulder.
Pull the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance facing C. Left side fist downward strike toward E.
Right pressing kick toward F, the hands held where they were.
Without setting the foot down, right middle side piercing kick toward F.
Lower the right foot toward F into a left L-stance facing F (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Left knife-hand high inward strike, the right side fist in front of the left shoulder.
Pull the right foot to the left foot into a closed stance facing C. Right side fist downward strike toward F.
Move the left foot to C into a left low stance. Right palm pressing block, slowly.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right low stance. Left palm pressing block, slowly.
Stamp the right foot back toward D into a sitting stance facing F. Right back fist high side strike toward D, with a kihap.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn into a right walking stance facing D. Right double forearm middle block.
Shift back toward C, keeping the right walking stance. Left forearm low block, the right arm held where it was.
Slip the right foot forward toward D into a right low stance. Right flat fingertip high thrust, slowly.
Stamp the left foot along the C–D line into a sitting stance facing F. Left back fist high side strike toward C, with a kihap.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn into a left walking stance facing C. Left double forearm middle block.
Shift back toward D, keeping the left walking stance. Right forearm low block, the left arm held where it was.
Slip the left foot forward toward C into a left low stance. Left flat fingertip high thrust.
Stamp the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance. Twin fist high vertical punch.
Stamp the left foot to A into a left walking stance facing A. Twin fist upset punch.
Right middle front snap kick toward A, the hands held where they were.
Lower the right foot, then move the left foot toward A into a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Move the left foot to B into a left walking stance. Left high punch.
Stamp the right foot forward toward B into a right walking stance. Twin fist upset punch.
Left middle front snap kick toward B, the hands held where they were.
Lower the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot toward B into a right L-stance facing A (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to A into a right walking stance. Right high punch.
